checks: Wrapped Studio starts at mobile viewport without JS errors.
Android exposes the direct-write Open action.
Folder permissions use the tree URI rather than its document URI.
Persisted folder restoration and UTF-8 companion read.
Writer buffers changes until close; reads do not overwrite files.
Close commits the exact prepared payload.
Stale revision rejects overwrite of an external update.
Aborting a writer does not change the document.
Detached Blob export survives immediate object-URL revocation.
Print HTML reaches the native print hook.
MMB save blocks concurrent edits and duplicate Save actions until complete.
Folder reconnects after reloading the app.
limitations: Mocked provider: Android SAF and physical-device behavior are not exercised.
No financial database is modified by this test.
